docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Smith's inquiry into the division of labour, markets, capital and the role of government, in five books.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Adam Smith (1723–1790), An Inquiry into the Nature and Causes of the Wealth of Nations (1776), in the edition of Edwin Cannan (1861–1935), 1904. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication). Modified: converted to this format.
